514:t_3:40.en:
$$キラ$$
「The Chairman was trying to draw out our...」

514:t_3:41.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「It is a factor destined to serve as an element in evolution into a superior species...」

514:t_3:42.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「I don't know exactly what it is either. But $$ギル$$ saw it in you.」

514:t_3:43.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「$$ギル$$ devised the $$デスティニープラン$$ to find that factor efficiently, while protecting it from $$クロノ$$, which forbids human evolution.」

514:t_3:45.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「That man seeks rationality and efficiency. I haven't told him this much.」

514:t_3:46.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「$$ギル$$ accepted that there would be opposition, and made himself the villain to implement this plan, which could be called an unjust law.」

514:t_3:47.en:
$$シン$$
「You're saying you'll carry on those aspirations?」

514:t_3:49.en:
$$シン$$
「Wake up, $$レイ#pt136$$! After $$ラウ・ル・クルーゼ$$, now you're going to be the Chairman's replacement!?」

514:t_3:50.en:
$$キラ$$
「Your life is your own! You learned that back then too!」

514:t_3:51.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「...Say whatever you like. But this is my own will.」

514:t_3:52.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「I'm not who I was then. I've found my own reason to live.」

514:t_3:53.en:
$$シン$$
「Then I'll stop you! What you're trying to do is wrong!」

514:t_3:54.en:
$$キラ$$
「$$レイ#pt136$$... You and I were both created according to someone else's intentions.」

514:t_3:55.en:
$$キラ$$
「But I... can't think of myself as a superior human being.」

514:t_3:56.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「What are you saying, when you're an $$スーパーコーディネイター$$ with the factor of evolution?」

514:t_3:57.en:
$$キラ$$
「I'm weak... I worry... And I've made mistakes again and again...」

514:t_3:58.en:
$$シン$$
「I'm the same, $$レイ#pt136$$! I don't know what this factor of evolution is, but I was a hopeless person!」

514:t_3:59.en:
$$シン$$
「But I'm fighting here now because everyone was there to help me!」

514:t_3:60.en:
$$キラ$$
「That grew from our encounters and partings with other people...」

514:t_3:61.en:
$$キラ$$
「Humans aren't gods. No one's plan can create a superior human being.」

514:t_3:62.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「But we should be able to increase the chances of that.」

514:t_3:63.en:
$$シン$$
「Who needs efficiency or rationality!? Living like human beings is far more important!」

514:t_3:64.en:
$$シン$$
「If the evolution the Chairman spoke of denies our humanity, I have no intention of becoming that!」

514:t_3:65.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「But humanity has no future if we simply follow our emotions.」

514:t_3:66.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「What the world needs from now on is a calm eye that can accept even the elimination of the unfit.」

514:t_3:67.en:
$$シン$$
「If you're talking about the fight against $$サイデリアル$$, we just have to defeat them!」

514:t_3:68.en:
$$シン$$
「Running away without even fighting is the same as abandoning the future!」

514:t_3:70.en:
$$連邦兵$$
「There he is! That's the Defense Committee Chairman!」

514:t_3:72.en:
$$シン$$
「Those bastards! They got all the way in here!?」

514:t_3:73.en:
$$連邦兵$$
「The mobile suit units outside are effectively a diversion.」

514:t_3:74.en:
$$連邦兵$$
「We're the main force! Die, you monster from space!!」

514:t_3:79.en:
$$連邦兵$$
「Damn it! Someone got in the way!」

514:t_3:80.en:
$$連邦兵$$
「Then we'll just kill them all!」

514:t_3:81.en:
$$キラ$$
「I won't let you do that!」

514:t_3:85.en:
$$連邦兵$$
「Th-that's impossible...! We took out all the $$ザフト$$ troops in the area...」

514:t_3:86.en:
$$ディアッカ$$
「Too bad. We're not $$ザフト$$.」

514:t_3:90.en:
$$アーサー$$
「It's what you'd call a coup, $$シン$$.」

514:t_3:92.en:
$$アーサー$$
「That's not my title anymore, though.」

514:t_3:94.en:
$$アーサー$$
「I have a report, Defense Committee Chairman. As of this moment, $$ザフト$$'s $$トライン$$ unit is leaving Headquarters' command.」

514:t_3:95.en:
$$アーサー$$
「There are many other units doing the same.」

514:t_3:97.en:
$$イザーク$$
「Even so, there are things we must protect.」

514:t_3:98.en:
$$ディアッカ$$
「Freedom, justice... And destiny... If we stay with $$ネオ・ジオン$$ any longer, we'll truly lose them.」

514:t_3:99.en:
$$アーサー$$
「$$シン$$, $$キラ$$. We've been waiting for this opportunity with the antiwar faction led by $$ラクス・クライン$$.」

514:t_3:101.en:
$$アーサー$$
「I was a crew member of the $$ミネルバ$$ too. I have no wish to repeat the tragic battles of the $$多元戦争$$.」

514:t_3:102.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「Will you shroud $$プラント$$'s future in darkness over emotional arguments?」

514:t_3:103.en:
$$キラ$$
「That's not it, $$レイ#pt136$$. Everyone is just trying to do what they've found to be right for themselves.」

514:t_3:104.en:
$$シン$$
「So... Don't let something like a mission bind you either...」

514:t_3:107.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「Why...? If you'd left me alone, I, the Defense Committee Chairman, would have fallen, and things would have gone the way you wanted...」

514:t_3:108.en:
$$シン$$
「How could I just watch a dear friend get shot right in front of me?」

514:t_3:110.en:
$$キラ$$
「It isn't a question of logic or efficiency. It's the result of $$シン$$'s feelings for you.」

514:t_3:111.en:
$$シン$$
「At least my emotions protected your future... Will you deny even that?」

514:t_3:113.en:
$$シン$$
「I'm fine with being an idiot...」

514:t_3:114.en:
$$シン$$
「And you shouldn't cry for me when I'm supposed to be your enemy.」

514:t_3:116.en:
$$アーサー$$
「Defense Committee Chairman. I'm sorry, but we must take you into custody.」

514:t_3:117.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「Never mind me. Treat $$シン$$ quickly.」

514:t_3:118.en:
$$ディアッカ$$
「OK. We don't enjoy watching our dear younger comrade suffer in pain either.」

514:t_3:119.en:
$$シン$$
「$$ディアッカ$$... Just lend me a first-aid kit, please.」
